# LanternBoard

LanternBoard is a fictional team task API for this RepoGuide demo snapshot.
All code here is original, MIT licensed, and never executed by RepoGuide.
The support URL is https://support.lanternboard.example.

## Architecture
Requests enter src/api.js. Authentication is checked by src/auth.js.
The service layer in src/tasks.js validates writes and enforces team ownership.
Database access lives in src/database.js; schema.sql defines the tables.
An in-memory fixed-window rate limiter protects the API per account.
Audit events contain IDs and action types, not task titles or passwords.

## Setup
Use Node 20+, install pg, and set DATABASE_URL in your own environment.
Run schema.sql against a local PostgreSQL database, then call createApi(db).
This is a teaching snapshot, not a production deployment or runnable package.
Never commit credentials. There is no password-reset or MFA implementation.

## API
GET /tasks lists active tasks for the signed-in user's team.
POST /tasks creates a task after title validation.
PATCH /tasks/:id/complete marks a team-owned task complete.
DELETE /tasks/:id soft-deletes a task; rows remain for audit history.

## Security boundaries
Passwords use scrypt with a random salt. Session tokens are random opaque values.
Only SHA-256 hashes of session tokens are stored. Sessions expire after 8 hours.
Every task query is parameterized and scoped to a team ID.
There is no cross-team administration endpoint in this snapshot.

## Testing
Tests demonstrate expiry, team isolation, title validation and the rate limit.
The tests use fake database adapters, not a real PostgreSQL server.

# Deployment notes
This fictional project has no hosted service.
A real deployment would need a web framework, HTTPS, input validation, migrations,
structured error handling and a durable shared rate limiter.
Audit storage is an in-memory ring buffer, not a compliance archive.
DATABASE_URL is supplied at runtime and must not be committed.
Backups, key rotation, MFA and password reset are outside this snapshot.
